<clarification_question>Le bug à corriger concerne le masquage de stderr par stdout dans les méthodes `assertSuccess` (runtime.ts) et `requireSuccess` (gitPromotion.ts). Confirmez-vous que le comportement attendu est : afficher **stderr** en premier si non vide, puis **stdout** si non vide, avec le format exact `Unable to <action>: [stderr] <message>\n[stdout] <message>`, et en cas de flux vides, afficher uniquement le code de sortie (ex: `Unable to <action>: exit code 1`) ?</clarification_question>
</proposed_plan>

```xml
<proposed_plan>
<interview_state>ready</interview_state>

## Approved decisions

- **Bug fix scope**: Correct stderr masking stdout in `assertSuccess` (runtime.ts) and `requireSuccess` (gitPromotion.ts) - both private methods
- **Error format**: `Unable to <action>: [stderr] <trimmed_message>\n[stdout] <trimmed_message>` with real newline
- **Display logic**: Show stderr first if non-empty, then stdout if non-empty; only non-empty trimmed streams included
- **Fallback**: `Unable to <action>: exit code N` when both streams are empty
- **Success behavior**: Unchanged - no modification to success cases
- **Preservation**: All private methods and interfaces remain unchanged; no duplication/truncation/deduplication
- **Testing**: 5 public API tests for `runCodex` using `fakeExecutor`/`sandboxScenario` in runtime.test.ts covering: two streams, stderr only, stdout only, none, success
- **Test updates**: Update existing affected expectations in runtime/promotion tests
- **Constraints**: No private/any access; no package/lock/dependency changes
- **Execution**: `npm ci` at root then `npm test` at root with real exit codes; no tail/pipefail/tsx
- **Artifacts**: Single vertical ticket in `.scratch` required; no ADR/glossary updates
- **Verification**: Targeted review of diff from BASE and approved docs only; T01 JSON object acp.implementation-result/v1; acp.verification-report/v1 review
- **Pipeline**: Full complete pipeline execution
</proposed_plan>
```
